messages:
jia: Quick bench update — ran continuous-batcher sweep for mosaic-13b-q4f16 on a mixed h100+a40 pool (us-west / eu-central). Params: batch_window=[10,20,50]ms, max_batch_tokens=[2048,4096]. p95 stable, but p99 in eu-central jumps ~2.6x with 50ms window when requests spill to a40. Kernel fallback shows 'no optimized matmul' path and KV-cache evictions.

tom: Did you capture KV eviction counts? Could be cache sizing + hetero kernel mismatch. :thinking_face:

maya: Yep — kv_evict spikes line up with p99. Grepped logs:

```
2026-03-18T09:11:22Z evict: kv_cache miss model=mosaic-13b-q4f16 shard=srv-a40-3 key_len=512
2026-03-18T09:11:22Z fallback: kernel=generic_matmul reason=no_opt_kernel_for_q4f16 device=a40
```

maya: Also saw batch coalescing increase on those nodes (more small microbatches merged -> longer tails).

eric: We've hit this before with hetero pools. Short checklist:
- try reducing max_batch_tokens for a40 nodes
- enable kernel-override for a40 (force quant-optimized kernel if available)
- prefer h100 for latency-sensitive routing or add soft-penalty to route score
- add KV cache pinning thresholds to avoid thrash

perf-bot: Automated summary (run=2143658701-sweep):

```
region      device   window_ms  max_tokens  p50_ms  p95_ms  p99_ms  qps
us-west     h100     10         2048        12      38      52      240
us-west     a40      10         2048        18      60      85      180
eu-central  h100     50         4096        14      45      58      220
eu-central  a40      50         4096        26      98      150     120  <-- spike
```

perf-bot: Notes: p99 ratio (a40 vs h100) increases with larger window and larger max_tokens; KV evictions correlate with regional routing flips.

ops-bot: Created INF-789: 'hetero-pool a40 kernel fallback -> p99 tail (mosaic-13b-q4f16)'. Attached logs and perf summary.

tom: I can try a targeted sweep: batch_window=15ms, max_tokens=3072, kernel-override=a40-quant-opt, and a routing soft-penalty for a40 for latency tags. Will run from us-west then eu-central.

maya: If you run it, add KB keyspace metrics and per-shard kv_size histograms. That helped last time.

eric: Also consider autoscaler cooldown tweaks — brief scale-ups were causing cold nodes with empty caches that then filled and evicted.

jia: Thanks all. Plan: tom will run the 15ms/3072 sweep + kernel-override; I'll correlate kv_evict + per-shard latency and update INF-789 with artifacts. If we still see a p99 > 2x, next step is routing change for latency-sensitive customers. :thumbsup:
